exam_scheme.note: NEET (UG) is conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA) on behalf of the National Medical Commission (NMC) as a single nationwide pen-and-paper (OMR-based) entrance examination for admission to undergraduate medical programs (MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BUMS, BSMS, BHMS, and B.Sc. Nursing) in all medical institutions across India including AIIMS and JIPMER. The examination is conducted in 13 languages (English, Hindi, and 11 regional languages).
